sections.Profile:
"Wrath of Olympus" is a solid-state pinball machine developed by Riot Pinball LLC and released in October 2015. This mythology-themed game features six flippers, a single pop bumper, two slingshots, 14 standup targets, two spinning targets, a drop target, a messenger ball, and an elevated playfield. Notable playfield elements include Pandora's Box on the right ramp, which locks balls for multiball, and a pop-up Hades bash toy.
